mapper.select: select ((select ifnull(sum(o.total_amount), 0) from wms_outbound o where o.status = '1' and o.delivery_status = '2' and coalesce(o.is_reversal, '0') = '0' and coalesce(o.reversed_flag, '0') = '0' and o.business_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate}) - (select ifnull(sum(ifnull(inv.tax_amount, 0)), 0) from fin_invoice inv where inv.status = '1' and inv.invoice_type = 'sale' and coalesce(inv.invoice_date, inv.business_date) between #{startDate} and #{endDate})) as sales_income_amount, (select ifnull(sum(sr.total_amount), 0) from wms_sale_return sr where sr.status = '1' and coalesce(sr.is_reversal, '0') = '0' and coalesce(sr.reversed_flag, '0') = '0' and sr.business_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate}) as sale_return_amount, ((select ifnull(sum(coalesce(cl.cost_amount, oi_fallback.fallback_cost)), 0) from wms_outbound o inner join ( select oi.outbound_id, oi.product_id, sum(coalesce(nullif(oi.base_quantity, 0), oi.quantity) * ifnull(p.cost_price, 0)) as fallback_cost from wms_outbound_item oi left join md_product p on oi.product_id = p.product_id group by oi.outbound_id, oi.product_id ) oi_fallback on oi_fallback.outbound_id = o.outbound_id left join ( select bill_id, product_id, sum(amount) as cost_amount from fin_cost_log where bill_type = 'outbound' group by bill_id, product_id ) cl on cl.bill_id = o.outbound_id and cl.product_id = oi_fallback.product_id where o.status = '1' and o.delivery_status = '2' and coalesce(o.is_reversal, '0') = '0' and coalesce(o.reversed_flag, '0') = '0' and o.business_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate}) - (select ifnull(sum(coalesce(cl.cost_amount, sri_fallback.fallback_cost)), 0) from wms_sale_return sr inner join ( select sri.sale_return_id, sri.product_id, sum(coalesce(nullif(sri.base_quantity, 0), sri.quantity) * ifnull(p.cost_price, 0)) as fallback_cost from wms_sale_return_item sri left join md_product p on sri.product_id = p.product_id group by sri.sale_return_id, sri.product_id ) sri_fallback on sri_fallback.sale_return_id = sr.sale_return_id left join ( select bill_id, product_id, sum(amount) as cost_amount from fin_cost_log where bill_type = 'sale_return' group by bill_id, product_id ) cl on cl.bill_id = sr.sale_return_id and cl.product_id = sri_fallback.product_id where sr.status = '1' and coalesce(sr.is_reversal, '0') = '0' and coalesce(sr.reversed_flag, '0') = '0' and sr.business_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate}) + (select ifnull(sum(case when cl.in_out = '2' then cl.amount else -cl.amount end), 0) from fin_cost_log cl inner join wms_inventory_check ic on ic.check_id = cl.bill_id where cl.bill_type = 'inventory_check' and ic.status = '1' and coalesce(ic.is_reversal, '0') = '0' and coalesce(ic.reversed_flag, '0') = '0' and coalesce(ic.business_date, date(ic.create_time)) between #{startDate} and #{endDate}) + (select ifnull(sum(case when cl.in_out = '2' then cl.amount else -cl.amount end), 0) from fin_cost_log cl where cl.bill_type = 'cost_adjust' and date(cl.create_time) between #{startDate} and #{endDate})) as sales_cost_amount, ((select ifnull(sum(amount), 0) from fin_expense where status = '1' and expense_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate}) + (select ifnull(sum(ifnull(fee_amount, 0)), 0) from fin_fund_transfer where status = '1' and ifnull(fee_amount, 0) > 0 and transfer_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate})) as expense_amount, ((select ifnull(sum(amount), 0) from fin_bad_debt where status in ('1', '2') and bad_debt_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate}) - (select ifnull(sum(change_amount), 0) from fin_fund_log where biz_type = 'bad_debt_recover' and direction = '1' and date(biz_date) between #{startDate} and #{endDate})) as bad_debt_amount

select ((select ifnull(sum(amount), 0) from fin_receipt where status = '1' and receipt_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate}) + (select ifnull(sum(change_amount), 0) from fin_fund_log where biz_type = 'bad_debt_recover' and direction = '1' and date(biz_date) between #{startDate} and #{endDate})) as income_amount, ((select ifnull(sum(amount), 0) from fin_payment where status = '1' and payment_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate}) + (select ifnull(sum(amount), 0) from fin_expense where status = '1' and expense_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate}) + (select ifnull(sum(ifnull(fee_amount, 0)), 0) from fin_fund_transfer where status = '1' and ifnull(fee_amount, 0) > 0 and transfer_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate})) as expense_amount, (((select ifnull(sum(amount), 0) from fin_receipt where status = '1' and receipt_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate}) + (select ifnull(sum(change_amount), 0) from fin_fund_log where biz_type = 'bad_debt_recover' and direction = '1' and date(biz_date) between #{startDate} and #{endDate})) - ((select ifnull(sum(amount), 0) from fin_payment where status = '1' and payment_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate}) + (select ifnull(sum(amount), 0) from fin_expense where status = '1' and expense_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate}) + (select ifnull(sum(ifnull(fee_amount, 0)), 0) from fin_fund_transfer where status = '1' and ifnull(fee_amount, 0) > 0 and transfer_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate}))) as net_amount

select '销售成本结转' as cost_type, ((select ifnull(sum(coalesce(cl.cost_amount, oi_fallback.fallback_cost)), 0) from wms_outbound o inner join ( select oi.outbound_id, oi.product_id, sum(coalesce(nullif(oi.base_quantity, 0), oi.quantity) * ifnull(p.cost_price, 0)) as fallback_cost from wms_outbound_item oi left join md_product p on oi.product_id = p.product_id group by oi.outbound_id, oi.product_id ) oi_fallback on oi_fallback.outbound_id = o.outbound_id left join ( select bill_id, product_id, sum(amount) as cost_amount from fin_cost_log where bill_type = 'outbound' group by bill_id, product_id ) cl on cl.bill_id = o.outbound_id and cl.product_id = oi_fallback.product_id where o.status = '1' and o.delivery_status = '2' and coalesce(o.is_reversal, '0') = '0' and coalesce(o.reversed_flag, '0') = '0' and o.business_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate}) - (select ifnull(sum(coalesce(cl.cost_amount, sri_fallback.fallback_cost)), 0) from wms_sale_return sr inner join ( select sri.sale_return_id, sri.product_id, sum(coalesce(nullif(sri.base_quantity, 0), sri.quantity) * ifnull(p.cost_price, 0)) as fallback_cost from wms_sale_return_item sri left join md_product p on sri.product_id = p.product_id group by sri.sale_return_id, sri.product_id ) sri_fallback on sri_fallback.sale_return_id = sr.sale_return_id left join ( select bill_id, product_id, sum(amount) as cost_amount from fin_cost_log where bill_type = 'sale_return' group by bill_id, product_id ) cl on cl.bill_id = sr.sale_return_id and cl.product_id = sri_fallback.product_id where sr.status = '1' and coalesce(sr.is_reversal, '0') = '0' and coalesce(sr.reversed_flag, '0') = '0' and sr.business_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate})) as cost_amount union all select '盘点损益' as cost_type, ifnull(sum(case when cl.in_out = '2' then cl.amount else -cl.amount end), 0) as cost_amount from fin_cost_log cl inner join wms_inventory_check ic on ic.check_id = cl.bill_id where cl.bill_type = 'inventory_check' and ic.status = '1' and coalesce(ic.is_reversal, '0') = '0' and coalesce(ic.reversed_flag, '0') = '0' and coalesce(ic.business_date, date(ic.create_time)) between #{startDate} and #{endDate} union all select '成本调价' as cost_type, ifnull(sum(case when cl.in_out = '2' then cl.amount else -cl.amount end), 0) as cost_amount from fin_cost_log cl where cl.bill_type = 'cost_adjust' and date(cl.create_time) between #{startDate} and #{endDate} union all select '坏账损失' as cost_type, ((select ifnull(sum(amount), 0) from fin_bad_debt where status in ('1', '2') and bad_debt_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate}) - (select ifnull(sum(change_amount), 0) from fin_fund_log where biz_type = 'bad_debt_recover' and direction = '1' and date(biz_date) between #{startDate} and #{endDate})) as cost_amount union all select '银行手续费' as cost_type, ifnull(sum(ifnull(fee_amount, 0)), 0) as cost_amount from fin_fund_transfer where status = '1' and ifnull(fee_amount, 0) > 0 and transfer_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate} union all select concat('费用-', expense_type) as cost_type, ifnull(sum(amount), 0) as cost_amount from fin_expense where status = '1' and expense_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate} group by expense_type

select p.product_id as productId, p.product_code as productCode, p.product_name as productName, ifnull(sale_agg.sale_qty, 0) as saleQty, ifnull(ret_agg.return_qty, 0) as returnQty, (ifnull(sale_agg.sale_qty, 0) - ifnull(ret_agg.return_qty, 0)) as netSaleQty, round(ifnull(sale_agg.sale_amount, 0), 2) as saleAmount, round(ifnull(ret_agg.return_amount, 0), 2) as returnAmount, round(ifnull(sale_agg.sale_amount, 0) - ifnull(ret_agg.return_amount, 0), 2) as netSaleAmount, round(ifnull(sale_agg.sale_cost, 0) - ifnull(ret_agg.return_cost, 0), 2) as costAmount, round((ifnull(sale_agg.sale_amount, 0) - ifnull(ret_agg.return_amount, 0)) - (ifnull(sale_agg.sale_cost, 0) - ifnull(ret_agg.return_cost, 0)), 2) as grossProfit, case when (ifnull(sale_agg.sale_amount, 0) - ifnull(ret_agg.return_amount, 0)) = 0 then 0 else round( ((ifnull(sale_agg.sale_amount, 0) - ifnull(ret_agg.return_amount, 0)) - (ifnull(sale_agg.sale_cost, 0) - ifnull(ret_agg.return_cost, 0))) * 100 / (ifnull(sale_agg.sale_amount, 0) - ifnull(ret_agg.return_amount, 0)), 2) end as grossMarginRate from md_product p left join ( select oi.product_id, sum(oi.qty) as sale_qty, sum(oi.amt) as sale_amount, sum(coalesce(cl.cost_amount, oi.fallback_cost)) as sale_cost from ( select o.outbound_id, i.product_id, sum(coalesce(nullif(i.base_quantity, 0), i.quantity)) as qty, sum(i.amount) as amt, sum(coalesce(nullif(i.base_quantity, 0), i.quantity) * ifnull(mp.cost_price, 0)) as fallback_cost from wms_outbound o inner join wms_outbound_item i on o.outbound_id = i.outbound_id left join md_product mp on i.product_id = mp.product_id where o.status = '1' and o.delivery_status = '2' and coalesce(o.is_reversal, '0') = '0' and coalesce(o.reversed_flag, '0') = '0' and o.business_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate} group by o.outbound_id, i.product_id ) oi left join ( select bill_id, product_id, sum(amount) as cost_amount from fin_cost_log where bill_type = 'outbound' group by bill_id, product_id ) cl on cl.bill_id = oi.outbound_id and cl.product_id = oi.product_id group by oi.product_id ) sale_agg on sale_agg.product_id = p.product_id left join ( select sri.product_id, sum(sri.qty) as return_qty, sum(sri.amt) as return_amount, sum(coalesce(cl.cost_amount, sri.fallback_cost)) as return_cost from ( select sr.sale_return_id, i.product_id, sum(coalesce(nullif(i.base_quantity, 0), i.quantity)) as qty, sum(i.amount) as amt, sum(coalesce(nullif(i.base_quantity, 0), i.quantity) * ifnull(mp.cost_price, 0)) as fallback_cost from wms_sale_return sr inner join wms_sale_return_item i on sr.sale_return_id = i.sale_return_id left join md_product mp on i.product_id = mp.product_id where sr.status = '1' and coalesce(sr.is_reversal, '0') = '0' and coalesce(sr.reversed_flag, '0') = '0' and sr.business_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate} group by sr.sale_return_id, i.product_id ) sri left join ( select bill_id, product_id, sum(amount) as cost_amount from fin_cost_log where bill_type = 'sale_return' group by bill_id, product_id ) cl on cl.bill_id = sri.sale_return_id and cl.product_id = sri.product_id group by sri.product_id ) ret_agg on ret_agg.product_id = p.product_id where ifnull(sale_agg.sale_qty, 0) > 0 or ifnull(ret_agg.return_qty, 0) > 0 order by grossProfit desc

select c.customer_id as customerId, c.customer_code as customerCode, c.customer_name as customerName, round(ifnull(ob.sale_amount, 0) - ifnull(sr.return_amount, 0), 2) as saleAmount, ifnull(ob.bill_count, 0) as orderCount, round(ifnull(ar.received_amount, 0) + ifnull(bd.recovered_amount, 0), 2) as receivedContribution, round(ifnull(ar.unpaid_amount, 0), 2) as unpaidAmount from md_customer c left join ( select customer_id, sum(total_amount) as sale_amount, count(outbound_id) as bill_count from wms_outbound where status = '1' and delivery_status = '2' and coalesce(is_reversal, '0') = '0' and coalesce(reversed_flag, '0') = '0' and customer_id is not null and business_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate} group by customer_id ) ob on ob.customer_id = c.customer_id left join ( select customer_id, sum(total_amount) as return_amount from wms_sale_return where status = '1' and coalesce(is_reversal, '0') = '0' and coalesce(reversed_flag, '0') = '0' and customer_id is not null and business_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate} group by customer_id ) sr on sr.customer_id = c.customer_id left join ( select customer_id, sum(ifnull(received_amount, 0)) as received_amount, sum(amount - ifnull(received_amount, 0) - ifnull(bad_debt_amount, 0)) as unpaid_amount from fin_receivable where biz_status = 'confirmed' and customer_id is not null group by customer_id ) ar on ar.customer_id = c.customer_id left join ( select customer_id, sum(ifnull(recovered_amount, 0)) as recovered_amount from fin_bad_debt where status in ('1', '2') and ifnull(recovered_amount, 0) > 0 and customer_id is not null group by customer_id ) bd on bd.customer_id = c.customer_id where c.del_flag = '0' and (ifnull(ob.bill_count, 0) > 0 or ifnull(sr.return_amount, 0) > 0) order by saleAmount desc

select p.product_id as productId, p.product_code as productCode, p.product_name as productName, greatest(ifnull(l.outbound_qty, 0), 0) as outboundQty, greatest(ifnull(l.inbound_qty, 0), 0) as inboundQty, ifnull(s.stock_qty, 0) as stockQty, case when ifnull(s.stock_qty, 0) = 0 then 0 else round(greatest(ifnull(l.outbound_qty, 0), 0) / ifnull(s.stock_qty, 0), 4) end as turnoverRate from md_product p left join ( select product_id, sum(case when bill_type in ('outbound', 'sale_return_unaudit', 'sale_return_reverse') and in_out = '2' then quantity when bill_type in ('outbound_unaudit', 'outbound_reverse', 'outbound_return', 'sale_return') and in_out = '1' then -quantity else 0 end) as outbound_qty, sum(case when bill_type in ('inbound', 'purchase_return_unaudit', 'purchase_return_reverse') and in_out = '1' then quantity when bill_type in ('inbound_unaudit', 'inbound_reverse', 'purchase_return') and in_out = '2' then -quantity else 0 end) as inbound_qty from wms_stock_log where create_time >= #{startDate} and create_time < date_add(#{endDate}, interval 1 day) group by product_id ) l on p.product_id = l.product_id left join ( select product_id, sum(quantity) as stock_qty from wms_stock group by product_id ) s on p.product_id = s.product_id where p.del_flag = '0' order by turnoverRate desc

select s.warehouse_id as warehouseId, coalesce(max(w.warehouse_name), concat('仓库#', s.warehouse_id)) as warehouseName, s.location_id as locationId, coalesce(max(loc.location_name), case when s.location_id = 0 then '默认库位' else concat('库位#', s.location_id) end) as locationName, p.product_id as productId, p.product_code as productCode, p.product_name as productName, s.batch_no as batchNo, ifnull(sum(s.quantity), 0) as stockQty, ifnull(sum(s.locked_quantity), 0) as lockedQty, ifnull(sum(s.quantity - ifnull(s.locked_quantity, 0) - ifnull(s.frozen_quantity, 0)), 0) as availableQty, round(ifnull(sum(s.quantity * coalesce(nullif(ca.avg_cost, 0), ifnull(p.cost_price, 0))), 0), 2) as stockAmount from wms_stock s left join md_product p on s.product_id = p.product_id left join md_warehouse w on s.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id left join md_location loc on s.location_id = loc.location_id left join ( select warehouse_id, product_id, avg_cost from fin_cost_account where cost_method = coalesce( (select config_value from sys_config where config_key = 'canglian.cost.defaultMethod' limit 1), 'moving' ) ) ca on ca.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id and ca.product_id = s.product_id group by s.warehouse_id, s.location_id, p.product_id, p.product_code, p.product_name, s.batch_no order by stockAmount desc

select '收款流入' as fundTypeName, 'receipt' as fundType, ifnull(sum(amount), 0) as amount from fin_receipt where status = '1' and receipt_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate} union all select '坏账收回流入' as fundTypeName, 'bad_debt_recover' as fundType, ifnull(sum(change_amount), 0) as amount from fin_fund_log where biz_type = 'bad_debt_recover' and direction = '1' and date(biz_date) between #{startDate} and #{endDate} union all select '采购付款' as fundTypeName, 'payment' as fundType, ifnull(sum(amount), 0) as amount from fin_payment where status = '1' and payment_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate} union all select '费用支出' as fundTypeName, 'expense' as fundType, ifnull(sum(amount), 0) as amount from fin_expense where status = '1' and expense_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate} union all select '银行互转手续费' as fundTypeName, 'transfer_fee' as fundType, ifnull(sum(ifnull(fee_amount, 0)), 0) as amount from fin_fund_transfer where status = '1' and ifnull(fee_amount, 0) > 0 and transfer_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate}
